# CACHE10 | Bounded dispatch

After CACHE09 source joined. Own memory and single-flight only; CACHE11 can run concurrently after CACHE09.

Commands from root. MODEL=Composer Standard. Sequential T-IDs. Parent forwards one card and named anchors; receipt: T-ID, files, test/count, negative result, contradiction if any. No live runs.

T01 | Weighted LRU. Anchors packages/cache/src/memory/index.ts, memory-store.test.ts. Move generic handle and public createWeightedLru to memory/weighted-lru.ts; createMemoryStore to memory/memory-store.ts; memory/index.ts thin existing exports. Replace entries/costs pair with Map<string,{value:T,cost:number}> and totalBytes; touch deletes/reinserts same record; remove subtracts exactly once; get copies and touches, peek copies, forEach supplies existing stored value only to internal purge. Preserve 128-byte overhead, admission order, replacement behavior, invalid weight rejection, copy callbacks and public signatures; no changes to expiry scanning complexity in this task. Remove non-null assertion by single-record lookup. Test existing LRU recency/weight/copy/oversize plus replacement accounting, remove/clear/reinsert and zero-weight bounded entries. pnpm --filter @offscreen/cache test.

T02 | Memory store copy boundary. Anchors memory/memory-store.ts, memory/weighted-lru.ts, memory-store.test.ts. Use one private handle get-if predicate (validates internal value, deletes on failed predicate, returns explicit missing/rejected/hit outcome; touch only on hit, copy exactly once on hit); memory get maps to existing miss/expired/hit outcomes. On set keep expiry check, purge, admission and copy ownership; pass original entry to handle, copy once at storage boundary. No exposure of stored bytes, no changes to estimated weights or purge cadence. Tests mutation isolation on both input and output, expired read deletes, oversize refusal and recency unaffected by rejected read. Run package tests.

T03 | Local single-flight. Anchors resilience/single-flight.ts, single-flight.test.ts, bounded-cache.test.ts. Replace per-key inFlightCountByKey map and summation with scalar activeGenerations increment at successful admission, decrement exactly once in endInFlightGeneration (including pre-aborted leader path). Keep mappedByKey identity guard, synchronous overload throws, existing abort ordering, waiter cap excludes leader. Replace waiter array with Set and attachedCoalesced counter updated on attach/detach/settle, with no counter increment for preaborted caller; detach removes and cleans once, settle clears and resets count. Keep loader starts only after generation mapped and leader attached, invalidation/clear removes joinability but never releases active capacity; finish of A cannot delete B. Preserve actual error object and coalesced marker. Narrate phases in run; use named join/start helpers if useful. Tests held invalidated generation still counts, overlapping replacement, preaborted leader releases capacity, cancel waiter frees waiter slot, clear while running, rejection cleanup. Do not change to async run or distributed lock. Run package tests.

T04 | Tier composition. Anchors memory/tiered-store.ts, memory/index.ts, tiered-store.test.ts. Move to src/tiered-store.ts; memory barrel reexports same function. Preserve precise sequential L1/L2 read/write result precedence, injected clock timing and absolute expiry; extract named outcome selection helpers only if useful, no parallel writes or new expiry semantics. Retain byte-copy boundary. Run package tests/typecheck. Parent updates README navigation after coordinating CACHE11, no semantic policy changes.
